description_en: Queries the tags attached to one or more EAIS resources
description_zh: 查询一个或多个EAIS资源已经绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun eais list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource resides. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The only valid value is `instance`
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。目前取值仅支持`instance`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. A maximum of 50 IDs can be specified
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. Constraints:

Cannot be empty.

A maximum of 128 characters in length.

Cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

Cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。限制：

不能为空。
最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Constraints:

A maximum of 128 characters in length.

Cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

Cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。限制：

最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: A list of tags. The list can contain a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en: The token to start the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始 Token。NextToken 为空说明为最后一个

TagResources.description_en: A collection of resources and their tags. This collection includes information such as resource IDs, resource types, and tag key-value pairs
TagResources.description_zh: 由资源及其标签组成的集合，包含了资源ID、资源类型和标签键值等信息

items.description_en: An object that contains information about a resource and its tags
